request: Build a moving lift in this empty project. A box named `Lift` (2 m wide, 0.2 m tall, 2 m deep) starts at x = 0, y = 0, z = 0 and moves straight up at 1.5 m/s until y = 3, then straight down at 1.5 m/s back to y = 0, and repeats forever, using game time (60 fixed ticks a second). A counter named `trips` starts at 0 and adds 1 each time the lift reaches the top.
